disclaimer: Experimental out-of-sample validated Poisson expected-goals models. Not betting advice.

runtimePolicy.reason: Home/away goals are modelled as independent Poisson counts; all markets derive from the same scoreline matrix so probabilities stay mutually consistent. Dixon-Coles adjustment is not deployed until separately validated.
runtimePolicy.totalsCalibration: Isotonic match-totals calibrators are embedded only when their cross-fitted within-validation logLoss gain clears the 0.0005 deadband.
